violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food with bare hands. - Cook handling salads with bare hand.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. - Hand sink used for washing lettuce.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Floor in walkin cooler has paint chips and needs repainting.
